{"id":1980387969,"question_id":3750,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months","timestamp":1776367359,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1980387969/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Closest Equal Element Queries","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> solveQueries(vector<int>& nums, vector<int>& queries) {\n        unordered_map<int , vector<int>>pos;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) pos[nums[i]].push_back(i);\n\n        vector<int>ans;\n        for(auto it : queries)\n        {\n            int nearest = INT_MAX;\n            if(pos[nums[it]].size() == 1)\n            {\n                ans.push_back(-1);\n                continue;\n            } \n\n            int startIndex = it;\n            int n = pos[nums[it]].size();\n            int m = nums.size();\n            \n            for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n            {\n                int curridx = pos[nums[it]][i];\n                if(curridx == startIndex) continue;\n\n                int forward = (curridx - startIndex + m) % m;\n                int backward = (startIndex - curridx + m) % m;\n\n                nearest = min({nearest , forward , backward});   \n            }\n            ans.push_back(nearest);\n        }\n\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"closest-equal-element-queries","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1925}
